description.default: Inspired by Cursor and Notion: a clean, modern layout and interaction. Adds CJK-Latin spacing, image optimization, favorites, and other highly requested features. Please use the theme and plugin together.
description.zh-CN: 参考 Cursor 和 Notion 优化布局和交互，主打简洁、现代化，提供中英文空格间隔、图片优化、收藏等呼声较高的功能。请务必插件和主题一起使用。
